name: Velocity Blur Scroll Gallery
description: Vertical gallery of 3D-tilted images zigzagging down the page while a giant blend-mode name marquee sweeps across. Scroll speed adds blur and desaturation to the images.
contents: Vertical list of images, each offset sideways in a sine wave
Fixed full-width marquee of uppercase names behind the images
Loading line overlay and radial vignette overlay
behavior: Each image rotates in 3D and moves in depth as it scrolls through the viewport
Scroll velocity drives blur and desaturation on the images
Marquee moves horizontally scrubbed by scroll, with blend mode over the images
Loader shows until images are loaded, positions recalculate on resize
editableByProps: Images, alt text and marquee names
Background, text, marquee and vignette colors, fonts and blend mode
Image size, aspect ratio, radius, gap and zigzag amplitude
3D rotation ranges, depth, blur strength and spacing above and below

needsCodeEdit.where: new Lenis() call inside the init function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the Google Fonts families loaded

fixed: Changes the page and html background color while mounted and resets it on unmount
Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Loads Space Grotesk and Inter from Google Fonts through a link added to the document head
Loader and vignette overlays are fixed to the viewport and cover the whole screen
